content.rendered:
A delightful blend of roses and berries! Roseberry Swirl features soft sponge layers infused with berry goodness, beautifully complemented by floral accents and creamy swirls. With a light and refreshing taste, this cake is perfect for elegant gatherings, tea parties, or any occasion that calls for a sophisticated treat.

Product Details:

  • Type: Strawberry flavours with Cream Delight
  • Eggless Cake
  • Weight: 1kg
  • Shape: Round |
  • Flavour: Black Forest | Serves: 7-9 people

NOTE – “WE CAN MAKE THIS DESIGN IN ALL FLAVOURS”

Care Instructions:

  • Store cream cakes in the refrigerator.
  • Fondant cakes should be kept in a cool, air-conditioned space.
  • Serve at room temperature, avoiding heat exposure.
  • Use a serrated knife for cutting fondant cakes.
  • Decorative elements may have toothpicks or wires—check before serving.
  • Consume within 24 hours for best taste.

 

Delivery Information:

  • Cakes are handcrafted; slight variations in design & shape may occur.
  • Delivery time is an estimate based on availability & location.
  • We attempt delivery only once as cakes are perishable.
  • Address changes post-order are not possible.
  • Actual product may slightly differ from the image shown.
  • Hand-delivered, not shipped via courier.

excerpt.rendered: An artistic masterpiece! Rose Designer Theme Cake is adorned with beautifully piped buttercream roses, intricate floral patterns, and a smooth, elegant finish. With its delicate flavors and stunning design, this cake is the perfect choice for weddings, anniversaries, and luxurious celebrations.
